entities.summary: Semyon Valuysky is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for HC Yugra of the Supreme Hockey League (VHL). He has formerly played for Torpedo Nizhny Novgorod, Metallurg Novokuznetsk, Lada Togliatti and Admiral Vladivostok.
